messages.author: aba808a7b471253f
messages.subject: Re: XML-RPC error
parts:
On May 14, 2013, at 10:50 AM, Grimes Mark wrote:

> Error: faultCode: 0 faultString: Failed to parse XML-RPC request: Failed to parse double value: NA

Hi Mark,

It looks like you are passing in node attributes which are NA. Perhaps you could check the node attribute values before you send? NAs are not currently expected by RCy, by XML-RPC, or by Cytoscape.

- Paul
